howto: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 du_tools.py deck.json goldfish|bracket3|bracket4|cedh 4000 [combo_from] for leave-one-out. compare() reports win-by-turn and 'raced' (opponents won first). deck.json = vault decks/doom-unrivaled ({cards:[{name,qty}]}).
modeled: Doom readiness/haste (Greaves, Boots, Lavaspur, Drawbridge, Hall, Elixir); Consultation, Tainted Pact (unique-name library), Leveler, Inverter, Doomsday pile, Entomb+Reanimate lines, Ad Nauseam/Peer digs, draw-out engines; burst mana held for wins; Jeweled Lotus; removal on Doom, combo disruption incl. fizzle when Doom is killed in response; cEDH opponents racing, stopped by held free interaction, stax and discard. Nov 16 (v2), the merged Doom + Ultron list, card text from mtg-data: creature tokens as sacrifice fodder (Doombots, Robots, Daleks, Zombies, Lashwrithe's Germ); Sagas (Age of Ultron, Genesis of the Daleks incl. the chapter IV choice, The War in Heaven returning Leveler, Phyrexian Scriptures as a blank); one drain total for each-opponent life loss, 40 wins (Ultron the Annihilator on every artifact that reaches the graveyard, Psychosis Crawler, Daleks, Exsanguinate); Leveler from the graveyard via Buried Alive, Persist, Grim Reaper's Scythe, Memorial to Folly, Doombot Harbinger, and Zombie Infestation as the discard outlet; Stargaze; Howling Mine; Peter Parker's Camera copying Doom's draw; Idol of Oblivion; Reclamation Specialist; Adaptive Omnitool carried by a token; Kingpin's Treasures; the six-mana Doctor Doom; Shred Memory transmuting for a 2-drop or Demonic Tutor; Splinter's Technique at full cost; Nasty End, Village Rites and Deadly Dispute now need something to sacrifice and draw; board wipes kill your creatures and tokens. Doomsday with no second Doom activation that turn must survive a trip around the table. The Soul Stone corrected to {1}{B}, taps for {B}. Bracket 3, 3,000 games: win by turn 8 52%, by 10 70%, by 16 86%; Leveler lines about 86% of wins, Doomsday about 11%, drain under 1%.
